title: Build API-only backend with Hono over file-based storage
description: Create a REST API that exposes all entity CRUD operations and agent operations. The API reads/writes the same JSON files that agents use directly. This achieves parity: agents work via files, clients work via API, same data.
acceptance_criteria: Node.js + Hono API server runs and serves JSON
Generic CRUD engine reads/writes entity JSON files
All entity types have REST endpoints
Operations endpoints to trigger agent capabilities
